guard: Jcode retries a first readiness turn that used its pre-MCP tool snapshot exactly once, still refuses a never-callable bridge without presence, opens the foreground TUI before readiness completes, records that bootstrap orientation predates an actual completed mesh join, bounds the readiness proof so a long turn cannot stay invisible, and names that pre-join gate in the connector log
why: Jcode locks its first turn's tool list before asynchronous MCP registration can complete. The connector cannot treat that first absent call as a permanent bridge failure, but must not advertise without a real later tool call either (#777).

The remaining cells pin the same boot ordering: the foreground observer must start while readiness is in flight (#779), and the transcript must explicitly supersede the truthful but stale pre-join orientation result only after a completed mesh join (#778, #845).
A heavy persona can keep the readiness turn alive with no mesh presence. The host now bounds that turn and names the pre-join gate in the connector log so an operator can tell it from a hang (#1216).

mutations.name: M1 remove the bounded retry after the pre-MCP snapshot
mutations.expectRed: a first-turn MCP snapshot race recovers on one bounded retry

mutations.name: M2 join without proving orientation after the retry
mutations.expectRed: a permanently absent cotal tool ends the launch

mutations.name: M3 move the foreground TUI behind readiness again
mutations.expectRed: foreground TUI starts before its readiness turn finishes

mutations.name: M4 omit the post-join correction for stale bootstrap context
mutations.find: `You are now connected to the Cotal mesh as "${config.name}". The earlier cotal_orientation result was captured before this join; use cotal_orientation again for live context.`,
mutations.expectRed: post-join context supersedes the pre-join orientation card

mutations.name: M5 do not await the completed mesh join before notifying Jcode
mutations.expectRed: post-join notice stays absent while the mesh is unreachable

mutations.name: M6 drop the host-side readiness turn bound
mutations.expectRed: a readiness turn that overruns its bound ends the launch

mutations.name: M7 omit the in-flight pre-join readiness diagnostic
mutations.expectRed: the connector log names the pre-join readiness gate while that turn is still running
